text: Every project keeps its cast and crew in one place. Open Manage cast and crew.
Add someone with their role, and Nia files them under the right department, with how to reach them.
The team is grouped by department, each person with their status and contact.
Filter by department or by status, to see at once who still needs confirming.
Confirm someone in one tap, and the count at the top keeps up: who's confirmed, out of the whole headcount.
Open anyone to see their contact details, agent, availability and notes.
Or switch to the grid, and see the whole team at a glance.
